facts.claim: Santa Marina's own 'Weddings & Celebrations' page (live, modified 23 October 2026) says the resort sits 'on the pristine shores of Mykonos', that its venues have 'scenic panoramas of the Aegean Sea', and that it has a 'traditional whitewashed stone chapel'. Re-check of Greece venues pack fact_10, fact_11: unchanged in substance.

Santa Marina says its 'experienced team of wedding planners' works with couples on intimate gatherings or grand celebrations, including bespoke menus, floral arrangements and elopement parties, and publishes a 2026 wedding brochure PDF and event menus PDF. Capacity, room count and exclusive use are not stated on the page read.

Santa Marina's site navigation lists Rooms, Suites and Villas, Santa Marina Beach, Oasis Pool, Buddha-Bar Beach Mykonos, Elais Restaurant, Private Dining and Ginkgo Spa; bookings run through Marriott (property code JMKLC), as a Luxury Collection resort.

Mykonos Grand Hotel & Resort describes itself as a five-star beachfront hotel on Ayios Yiannis (Agios Ioannis) beach, opposite the island of Delos, a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World, with a private beach section reserved for hotel guests. Its home page meta description mentions 'Cycladic charm'.

Mykonos Grand's weddings page says its whitewashed chapel dedicated to the Virgin Mary is 'perched on a hill looking out over Ayios Yiannis Beach'; it holds up to 25 guests indoors and serves as a backdrop for outdoor ceremonies for up to 100 guests. The hotel will liaise with the couple's wedding planner and arranges music, video and photography, beauty salon services and flowers.

Mykonos Grand states that both bride and groom must be Christian Orthodox to perform a (religious) wedding within the hotel premises. Its amenity list also names an open-air amphitheatre and a complimentary evening shuttle to Mykonos Town. Accommodation includes rooms, suites with private pools and the Mykonos Grand Villa; total room count and exclusive use are not stated on the pages read.

Belvedere Hotel's home page places it on the edge of Mykonos Town near Rohari Hill, opposite the School of Fine Arts; it is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World with 31 rooms, 9 suites and 1 Mansion in the main hotel, plus a Waterfront Villa, Villa Next Door and 26 Hilltop Rooms and Suites about 250 m away. It says it is 'designed on the principle of a Cycladic neighbourhood'. The home page does not mention weddings.

Belvedere Hotel's contact page lists a 'Private Events' contact alongside reservations and guest relations, but neither the home page nor the contact page says the hotel hosts weddings, and a site-restricted search of belvederehotel.com for weddings or events returned no weddings page (only an events archive of restaurant openings and its historic White Parties). Belvedere does not meet the inclusion rule on this check.

Katikies Hotels' group events page says that across its Santorini and Mykonos hotels it creates bespoke events 'whether it's a lavish wedding, or a corporate event', lists Weddings and 'Hotel Take over' among enquiry event types, and offers 'Micro weddings at Katikies Hotels in Santorini or Mykonos', described as small, exclusive ceremonies 'featuring classic Cycladic architecture'. Re-check of Greece venues pack fact_300, fact_302: unchanged.

Katikies events page lists four Katikies Mykonos venues: Upper deck (seated 50, standing 100, 'Ideal for wedding ceremonies; private dinners; standing cocktail receptions'); Botrini's Restaurant (seated 50, standing 60); Fleur de Miraval (seated 50, standing 80); Private Balcony (seated 20, standing 20). Only the Upper deck is marked for wedding ceremonies.

Katikies Mykonos describes itself as a 5-star hotel and member of The Leading Hotels of the World 'above the sun kissed beach of Agios Ioannis', about 4 km from Mykonos Town (about a 10-minute drive); all rooms and suites look to Agios Ioannis beach and most have sea views to Delos; children above 13 are welcome (younger children are directed to sister property Katikies Villas Mykonos at Elia beach). Room count is not stated on the page read.

Kivotos (Kivotos Hotels, Mykonos) has an official 'Luxury Weddings in Mykonos' page saying the beachfront hotel 'has a private chapel within its premises', with specialised wedding coordinators handling items from marriage licences to decoration, music and food. The page opens with 'The fairytale like scenery of Cyclades'. Page last modified February 2022.

Kivotos says its most popular wedding reception venue is the entire area around the main pool on the hotel's lower level, against the Aegean backdrop, and offers three named wedding packages (Dreamy Life, Live Life & Love Life, Get Together) that include help with municipal paperwork. Guest capacity, room count and exclusive use are not stated on the page read.

Kivotos Mykonos's home page says the hotel overlooks Ornos Bay, has 40 suites and villas set 'in harmony with nature's handiwork and the classic Cycladic design' down a rocky hillside to its own private beach, reserved for hotel guests and wind-protected, and is a member of L.V.X Preferred Hotels & Resorts.

Kivotos says private meals, intimate gatherings or small cocktail parties can be held by the beach, in a separate private area or on board the hotel's yacht; its weddings page names the hotel's privately owned schooner 'Prince de Neufchatel' as a honeymoon option.

Bill&Coo's 'Celebrations & Events' page (billandcoo.com/retreats) says 'We curate refined luxury weddings and events' under a Weddings & Celebrations heading, calls its venues 'A remarkable backdrop for any celebration, wedding, or event', and offers 'Exclusive Private Events' where couples can host the celebration in one of its venues and accommodate guests in rooms and suites available for private bookings, 'having an entire venue dedicated to your event'. Beefbar Mykonos on Bill&Coo Beach is named as a beachside event venue. Capacities are not stated.

Bill&Coo's home page calls itself 'A love letter to Cyclades', 'overlooking the Aegean Sea', a Leading Hotels of the World member, with three stays: Bill&Coo Mykonos ('a sea view escape near Mykonos Town', where the Valmont Spa is, 'minutes from town'), The Coast Bill&Coo ('intimate seaside retreat') and Private Villas. The LHW member link names Megali Ammos.

The Coast Bill&Coo is described on its own page as 'an intimate, adults-only beachside retreat' on the bay of Agios Ioannis, about seven minutes from Mykonos Town, with 25 suites in 'a subtle homage to authentic Cycladic design' and terraces looking over the Aegean to Delos; its menu links to a separate 'Celebrate' page (billandcoo.com/coast/retreats). Which Bill&Coo property hosts a given wedding is not stated on the pages read.

Rocabella Mykonos: the official site rocabella-hotel-mykonos.com could not be read live (home, contact and stay pages each timed out on 2026-11-11). Only a search snippet of its contact page mentions 'wedding & events inquiries', and a stay page snippet places it about 300 m from Agios Stefanos beach. Under the inclusion rule (live read, never snippets alone) Rocabella does not qualify on this check.

Santa Marina's 2026 wedding brochure PDF (linked from the weddings page) timed out and was not read, so no capacity, room count, ceremony type or exclusive-use detail is recorded from it. Prices in it, if any, are excluded by instruction.

Santa Marina's home page structured data describes it as 'a beachfront retreat on a private peninsula at the southern tip of Ornos Bay, Mykonos', with rooms, suites and villas with Aegean views, infinity pools, a private sandy beach and the Ginkgo Spa, 'just minutes from Mykonos Town'; the resort is marking 40 years. It does not use the word 'Cycladic' on the pages read.

insider_details.detail: Agios Ioannis gives two chapel-led options a short way apart: Mykonos Grand's hilltop chapel holds 25 inside with outdoor ceremonies up to 100, while Katikies Mykonos marks only its Upper deck (seated 50) for ceremonies. Over 50 seated guests points to Mykonos Grand; under 50 suits either.

Mykonos Grand hosts religious ceremonies on its premises only when both partners are Christian Orthodox, so couples planning a civil or symbolic ceremony should confirm in writing which ceremony types each shortlisted venue will host before paying a deposit.

Ornos Bay holds two very different scales: Santa Marina is a full resort on its own peninsula with a stone chapel and in-house wedding planners, while Kivotos has 40 suites and villas, its own chapel and a pool-level reception area, a natural fit for a smaller wedding where most guests stay on site.

Several venues set age limits that matter for family weddings: Katikies Mykonos welcomes children over 13 only and The Coast Bill&Coo is adults-only, so couples with young nieces and nephews on the guest list need a room-block plan that includes a family-friendly property.

Bill&Coo is the clearest option in this batch for a private, whole-venue celebration: it states that guests can be accommodated in rooms and suites booked privately with 'an entire venue dedicated to your event'. The Coast has 25 suites, so check how many guests that houses before treating it as exclusive use.

BOOKING CHECKLIST: Kivotos Mykonos: chapel capacity, pool-terrace reception capacity, music curfew, minimum nights, room block or exclusive use of the 40 suites and villas, rain plan, set-up times.

Kivotos wedding packages include transfers and paperwork help; the brief bars transfer arrangements and paperwork detail, so the writer should not repeat them.
